in_marathi.name: Amanisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Immortal, Enduring, Everlasting
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amanisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amanisha is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is composed of two parts: ‘Ama’ meaning immortal or enduring, and ‘Nisha’ meaning night or rest. This name signifies one who is everlasting and enduring, like the night that never ends.
